Dana (Eng): Quick follow-up from the Q&A: customer asked if Redwood can retain audit logs for 7 years and ship them to their SIEM. Any short guidance?

Ken (Security): Short: supported for Private deployments with sizing and contract terms. Default Hosted=90d, Dedicated=1y. Private can be configured multi-year but requires storage estimate + legal sign-off. Exports: S3, syslog over VPC, Kafka.

Rhea (Product): Note: Console path for export is Settings > Audit Logs > Export. Long retention -> lifecycle to colder storage recommended. Egress/storage costs apply.

Luca (Privacy): Flag: >12 months may need DSAR/region review (EU/UK/CN). We need a documented redaction/search process for archived logs.

Dana (Eng): For BYOK: can customers provide signing keys so Redwood never sees the material?

Ken (Security): Yes. BYOK/KMS supported (AWS KMS, Azure Key Vault, HashiCorp, on-prem HSM). We only store key references/grants; signing calls happen to customer KMS/HSM.

Dana (Eng): Is there an example CLI to enable S3 export?

Ken (Security): Example: ```redwoodctl logs export enable --dep dp-77 --target s3://acct-audit --encrypt --kms arn:aws:kms:region:acct:key/xyz``` Ensure VPC endpoints and IAM/grants are configured first.
